rounds.report:
L1 proxy reconstruction, CineRecon Three.js sampled-frame baseline (video49, 1152x720, 60 fps, 378 frames, 6.3 s).

Geometry: one continuous first-person shot. A ramped lane (vertex-coloured heightfield: grey road, sandy right side) climbs to a gate wall (extruded shape with pointed arch) holding two door leaves on hinge pivots; red "B" strokes and two lying barrels to the right of the arch; on the left a flat wall, a round tower protruding into the lane, a tall building and two crates (wide crate + tall white crate); on the right a pole, sandstone block stacks, a round building, and a distant building. Beyond the gate, a courtyard frame holds the crate with stacked cardboard boxes (main target), a back wall with round arch, a covered passage at right, a large blue-banded building with a corner tower at left, concrete slabs, a side-on car, and a tree. Sky is a vertex-coloured dome.

Articulation / actions: camera-attached viewmodel with two sleeve+glove arms posed by keyframes; knife held in the first ~0.5 s, empty switch, grenade held 1.0-2.2 s, both-hand pin pull at ~1.9 s, left hand extended while the right hand winds back, right-arm throw at ~3.95-4.1 s, then M4 rifle draw (raised near 5.2 s, settled from 5.5 s). The door leaves are slightly ajar and are pushed open (about 10 -> 50 deg) as the camera passes through at 2.75-3.3 s. The thrown grenade follows an analytic ballistic arc into the arch behind the crate with a blue trail made of preallocated cylinder segments, visible from 4.25 s.

Camera and timing: a single shot with no cuts; vertical FOV 74 deg; positions, yaw and pitch keyed at all 24 sample times (estimated from gate/crate image sizes and positions) and Hermite-interpolated; eye height follows the ground. Yaw turns left about 45 deg during the door passage, then the camera advances slowly on the crate with small right/left yaw corrections.

Observed vs inferred: key poses come from the 24 reference samples; motion between samples, exact ramp shape, door angles, grenade flight path and the out-of-view layout are inferred. No render feedback has been received yet for this initial version.

Observed vs inferred: key poses come from the 24 samples; between-sample motion, ramp profile, door angles, grenade path and unseen layout are inferred. Remaining: proxy appearance only; pitch values in early frames are estimates.
